title: Nvidia signs a $1.5B accord with Amkor, involving a prepayment by Nvidia to help bolster Amkor's chip packaging facility in Arizona; AMKR jumps 16%+ after hours (Bloomberg)
summary: Bloomberg: Nvidia signs a $1.5B accord with Amkor, involving a prepayment by Nvidia to help bolster Amkor's chip packaging facility in Arizona; AMKR jumps 16%+ after hours — Nvidia Corp. signed a $1.5 billion agreement with Amkor Technology Inc. to help bolster the company's chip packaging facilities …
